remove_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x502)
add_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x600)

spec2def(portcls.sys portcls.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# Original C++ object mechanics remain only in these validation oracle targets.
# Their real compilation commands drive pre-payment C/C++ validation and anchors.
add_library(portcls_resource_reference OBJECT EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL resource_rust_reference.c)
add_library(portcls_resource_bridge_check OBJECT EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL resource_rust_bridge.cpp)

# portcls.sys is all Rust (portcls-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/portcls-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# resource.cpp # replaced by sdk/lib/rust/portcls-rust/src/resource_*.rs
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(portcls_shims OBJECT adapter.cpp api.cpp connection.cpp dispatcher.cpp dll.cpp dma_slave.cpp drm.cpp drm_port.cpp filter_topology.cpp filter_dmus.cpp filter_wavecyclic.cpp filter_wavepci.cpp filter_wavert.cpp interrupt.cpp irp.cpp irpstream.cpp miniport.cpp miniport_dmus.cpp miniport_fmsynth.cpp pin_dmus.cpp pin_wavecyclic.cpp pin_wavepci.cpp pin_wavert.cpp pool.cpp port.cpp port_dmus.cpp port_topology.cpp port_wavecyclic.cpp port_wavepci.cpp port_wavert.cpp port_wavertstream.cpp power.cpp propertyhandler.cpp purecall.cpp registry.cpp service_group.cpp undoc.cpp unregister.cpp version.cpp guid.cpp)
target_link_libraries(portcls_shims PRIVATE libcntpr libntoskrnl libks libdrmk libhal)
if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "Clang")
    target_compile_options(portcls_shims PRIVATE "-Wno-missing-braces")
endif()
add_cargo_module(portcls portcls-cargo portcls.sys
    KIND kernelmodedriver
    BODY_CRATE portcls-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32/drivers
    EXTRA_DEPENDS portcls_shims psdk asm)
